title: Using modifiers
description:
Filters work on the row level: they return only the rows that match
certain conditions without changing the shape of the rows. Modifiers are
everything else. They sort the rows, limit how many come back, or change
the format of the response, for example to a CSV string.

Modifiers come after filters. Some modifiers only apply to queries that
return rows, such as `select()` or a database function that returns a
table.

The examples use the typed `table()` API with types
[generated from your database schema](/docs/guides/api/rest/generating-types).
Where a modifier takes a column, the column is a generated constant, such
as `Countries.name`. On `from()` the same modifiers take column names as
strings.
